issues.title: ❌ Image is Blank or Empty
issues.description: The uploaded image appears to be blank, white, or contains no meaningful design content. There are no elements to assess for accessibility compliance.
how_to_fix: 📸 Upload a design image with actual content
✏️ Ensure the image contains UI elements, text, buttons, or other design components
✏️ The image should not be entirely white, blank, or uniform in color

accessibility.summary: Cannot assess accessibility on a blank image. Please upload a design.
